ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels occupy approximately 85% of the visible surface; low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels occupy approximately 15% concentrated at the trailing edges and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central contiguous white region. Dark pigmentation forms a continuous linear band along the entire trailing edge and distal tips. Specific focal dark spots (rings) are mapped in the upper-left quadrant and near the central base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 85 degrees and high relative depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations consisting of sharp peaks and shallow valleys across the continuous boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in acute, slightly tapered tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of four circular, dark-contoured clusters: three localized on the distal left lobe and one near the median notch base.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct, unaligned vertical dark linear mark in the lower-left central quadrant of the ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible circular scarring consistent with barnacle attachment sites and a single linear rake-style mark; no major structural amputations visible.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, horizontally oriented dark focal mark positioned near the lower right region of the fluke base.
